gemini.api_family: Gemini Developer API generateContent and cachedContents REST v1beta

explicit_cache_objects.ttl: caller ttl or expireTime; default one hour when omitted; expireTime always returned
explicit_cache_objects.usage: CachedContent.usageMetadata.totalTokenCount reports tokens consumed by the cached content

generate_usage.promptTokenCount: total effective prompt including cached content
generate_usage.cachedContentTokenCount: cached portion of the effective prompt

gemini.eligibility: explicit cache minimum varies by model; gemini-2.5-flash is 2048 input tokens on the retrieved guide; cached tokens count against token limits
gemini.retry: REST has no response attempt field; official SDKs retry transient timeouts, network errors, 429, and 5xx with exponential backoff by default; the bounded probe disables retries with one attempt per native request

opencode.semantics: Gemini protocol maps promptTokenCount minus cachedContentTokenCount to non-cached input, cachedContentTokenCount to cache read, candidatesTokenCount to visible output, and thoughtsTokenCount to reasoning. Explicit CachedContent control is out-of-band and not wired; step-finish has no cache-object identity, TTL, responseId, resolved modelVersion, provider request identity, or retry count.
